product_summary: Ahmedabad (Gota, Gujarat) manufacturer/contract manufacturer of air & gas treatment equipment, sold under own brand ARIES PRO (ariespro.in) plus imported Airrane (South Korea) membranes. Real product lines per own websites: (1) compressed-air line filters and precision filter elements (3 um / 0.1 um / 0.01 um grades P/M/S, borosilicate glass-fibre wound & pleated elements) — ariespro.in/filters; (2) activated carbon removal filters; (3) refrigerated air dryers, 10/16/40 bar, compact-modular; (4) modular desiccant dryers; (5) modular nitrogen gas generators (PSA/membrane on-site N2); (6) automatic drain traps; (7) industrial valves; (8) nitrogen and biogas upgrading separation membranes (Airrane) — daltech.in/portfolio; (9) chemicals/adsorbents: activated alumina, zeolite molecular sieves, carbon molecular sieves, oxygen molecular sieves — listed on ariespro.in home page. Declared 842139 (machinery for filtering/purifying gases) is correct and is the core line (line filters, activated carbon filters, filter housings), but it covers only part of the portfolio: dryers (8419), N2 generators (8419.60), membranes (8421.99 parts / 8421.39), valves (8481.80) and the molecular-sieve/activated-alumina chemicals (3815/3824) are not reflected in the single declared code.
comment: HS 842139 = partial match. It is genuinely the company's main product family (compressed-air line filters, precision filter elements, activated carbon removal filters — ariespro.in/filters), so the code is not wrong, just incomplete. Missing from the declaration: refrigerated and desiccant dryers (HS 8419.39/8419.89), modular nitrogen gas generators (8419.60), nitrogen/biogas separation membranes and their elements (8421.39 / 8421.99), industrial valves (8481.80), and adsorbent chemicals — activated alumina, zeolite/carbon/oxygen molecular sieves (3815.90 or 3824.99 depending on formulation). Trader signs: the site itself states 'high-performance contract manufacturing' and the membrane line is explicitly imported from Airrane (South Korea) and resold for the Indian market; chemicals and valves are also resold lines rather than own production — so role is manufacturer_trader, not pure manufacturer. Industry claim 'Нефтегаз и химия' is a misclassification of the primary activity: the company is an air/gas-treatment and compressed-air equipment maker (pharma, food & beverage, automotive, electronics, laser cutting, metallurgy are its stated end markets); oil & gas and chemicals are only secondary applications/adjacent product lines. No HS line is corroborated by any customs record in this review — all product mappings above are derived from the company's own websites (daltech.in, ariespro.in) and are therefore 'заявлено, не подтверждено' as regards actual shipment classification. Per project rule 3, no rejection on HS grounds: company retained, code corrected/expanded to the actual portfolio.
